en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an inner courtyard surrounded by Renaissance-style arcaded galleries with multiple arched loggias and a steep tiled roof with dormer windows. A small domed staircase tower stands in the middle of one side, and an ornate well or fountain is visible in the courtyard. At the lower left margin of the image, a caption in cursive script reads "Graz Landhaushof."
